messages:
Harper Moon: Drafting a lightweight launch flow for next week: blog launch post + 15m webinar + 30-token starter pack. goal: measure delta on 5-request activation and webinar RSVPs.
Elliot Grant: Solid. two quick experiment knobs: (1) credit placement (claim on post vs claim on RSVP confirm) (2) CTA creative ("Try in 5 requests" vs "Join 15m live").
Priya Shah: Agree. propose 3 arms:
- Control: post + webinar CTA only
- Arm A: post -> claim 30 tokens -> RSVP modal shown after claim
- Arm B: post -> RSVP -> token in confirmation email
We can measure RSVP rate, token redemption rate, time-to-first-5, and 14-day paid conversion.
Sam Wilson: Routing: enterprise domains -> SFDC lead + tag "launchflow-30t"; others -> growth inbox. If redeemed_tokens >= 100 -> SDR task. Also webhook to #growth-ops for all claims.
Harper Moon: Timeline: assets by Tue noon, tracking wired by Wed, soft-launch Thu 9am PT to 5k seeded users. run 10 days. postmortem 1 week after campaign end.
Elliot Grant: Events (Mixpanel):
```
launch_post_view
webinar_rsvp
token_claimed_launchflow
promptpack_installed
first_5_requests
paid_conversion_14d
```
Add property campaign: "launchflow-30t-apr" and credit_offer_source = post|rsvp_email.
Priya Shah: Creative needs: hero image, 2 social cards, 2 email templates (invite + confirm), and 1 20s demo clip. Subject-line A: "Try Redwood in 5 requests 1 tokens included"; B: "Join our 15m webinar + credits". split by cold/warm.
Sam Wilson: Analytics nuance: dedupe users who click post -> claim -> RSVP vs post -> RSVP -> claim. keep a property "claim_sequence": pre-rsvp|post-rsvp.
launch-bot: reminder: feature-flag "launchflow_fastpath" created (default off).
Harper Moon: Ops ask: can eng enable a temporary fast-path model for claim traffic and webinar attendees during first 48h? low latency is crucial for demo success.
Elliot Grant: tagging eng-ml. also want a tiny dashboard showing per-arm: RSVP%, claim%, first_5% and cost per activated user (tokens * token_cost + infra). token_cost estimate 0.0008 USD/token; infra uplift 12%.
Priya Shah: Post-launch benchmark doc outline: hypothesis, cohort sizes & channels, funnel metrics, token economics, latency impact, creative performance, surprises, next steps. we'll fill with screenshots and dashboard links.
Sam Wilson: Routing detail: webhook payload to #growth-ops = {"campaign":"launchflow-30t-apr","email_domain":"...","redeemed_tokens":n,"claim_sequence":"..."} and SFDC mapping for enterprise.
Harper Moon: final checks: QA tracking by Wed, creative ship Tue noon, ops toggle Wed AM. I'll post the launch checklist in #marketing-prod tomorrow at 10am. thanks :rocket:
